player_prompt.intro:
Esi enye Player {player_id} ({role}) le {num_rounds}-round Matching Pennies dzi. 
- Le hafe, ŋlɔ '[heads]' kple '[tails]' (kple [h], [t]).
- Eɖokui wò na wòakpa ɖe ɖokui, Player 0 xɔ hafe; ɖokui wò na wòakpa ɖe ɖokui, Player 1 xɔ hafe.
Mia gba gbagba le '[heads]' kple '[tails]' ɖe ŋkɔ.

message.round_match: Player 0 picked {choice0}; Player 1 picked {choice1}. Match -> Player 0 wins
message.round_mismatch: Player 0 ɖe {choice0}; Player 1 ɖe {choice1}. Mismatch -> Player 1 xɔ eŋu.

outcome.p0_wins: Fefewɔla 0 ɖu dzi le ho geɖe me.
outcome.p1_wins: Fefewɔla 1 ɖu dzi le ho geɖe me.
